resources.string: A layout contains the 10 kana keys and the punctuation key, with their maps and popup shapes. The selected layout is used by Free Flick. Popup position and nearest-selection settings are shared.
Use a unique name (1–64 characters). Up to 32 layouts can be saved.
Delete “%1$s”? Input will switch to the standard 12-key flick layout.
Add “%1$s” as a saved layout? Existing layouts will be kept. If its name is already used, a number will be added. Select it afterwards to use it for input.
Layout added. Select it to use it for input.
Cannot import this file. Choose a supported Free Flick layout JSON file (up to 1 MB) with valid maps and popup shapes.
Could not write the layout file. Check the destination and try again.
Could not update this layout. It may have been removed or the saved-layout limit may have been reached.
Saved layouts could not be read. The stored data has been kept.
Choose a key and map to inspect. Try starts from the starting map. Previewing does not select or edit the layout.
